/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
run_tmp=$(find "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '"'acropolis-live.*' -print | sort | tail -n 1)
for query in \\
 'college=AITR&isActive=true' \\
 'college=AITR' \\
 'isActive=true&fields=name,slug,code,isActive,college,category' \\
 'college=AITR&isActive=true&limit=100'; do
  safe="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$query" | tr '"'&=?' '___')
  out=\""'$run_tmp/query_${safe}.json"
  curl --insecure --fail --show-error --silent --location --max-time 45 -A '"'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; verification-worker/1.0)' \"https://api-platform.acropolis.in/api/v1/departments?"'$query" -o "$out"
  printf '"'%s count=' \""'$query"
  jq -r '"'if (.data|type)==\"array\" then (.data|length) else \"nonarray\" end' \""'$out"
  jq -r '"'.data[]? | [.code,.name,(.isActive|tostring),(.college|join(\",\"))] | @tsv' \""'$out" | sed -n '"'1,80p'
done"

sociological, educational, physical, and economic factors that combine

Development Cell at Acropolis Group works towards achieving this goal.

Scholarship
